title: Data Analyst
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

### **Purpose of role**

* The Data Analyst is a key member of the Kilimanjaro Transformation Pprogramme, responsible for the accuracy, consistency and integrity of Keyloop’s product and pricing data, with a primary focus on legacy SKU mapping and catalogue validation

* The Data Analyst works closely with Pricing, Product Management and, Finance and Billing to ensure that legacy SKUs are accurately mapped to the Product Index architecture and that catalogue and CPQ data reflects the agreed pricing logic

### **Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own the mapping of legacy SKUs to the Product Index architecture, documenting the mapping rationale, dependencies and exceptions for each SKU

* Extract, cleanse and reconcile data from legacy systems, the data warehouse and Salesforce, ensuring a clear audit trail from source to target

* Work with Billing and Finance to ensure that mapped SKUs remain consistent with contract and invoice data

### **Key Skills**

* Proven experience in data analysis, data mapping and validation of large, complex datasets (ideally product, catalogue or pricing data)

* Proficient in Excel, including advanced lookups, pivot tables, data cleansing and reconciliation

* Comfortable with Salesforce or similar – including database manipulation, extraction and validation

* Strong attention to detail, with a structured approach to investigating legacy data and resolving ambiguity

* Strong written and verbal communication, with good stakeholder management across Pricing, Product, Finance and Billing

* Able to work independently and deliver to programme deadlines in a fixed-term environment

### **Desired, but not essential:**

* Experience with Salesforce CPQ – including product catalogue architecture, pricing rules and data migration/validation

* Experience working on a large CRM, ERP or data migration programme

* Experience with B2B Software as a Service (SaaS) products and pricing

* Comfortable with Power BI

* Experience working in an international environment

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

title: Analyst Project Analytics - Finance
description:

We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

To provide financial support to the project management functions within Operations. Assist with reviewing overall performance, including scope, revenue, cost and other related matters. Act as a liaison between Operations and Finance to ensure accurate and timely reporting of all activity and to proactively identify potential issues and action plans.

2. 5-6 years of relevant experience and specifically in financial planning, budgeting, and analysis is highly desirable.

Die Position
  
  
Job description
  
The Principal Business Analyst possesses in-depth knowledge of the pharma clinical data management business domain and understanding of data engineering& analytics technologies, operating at the intersection of business strategy, data, and technology needs.
  
In this role, you will apply systems thinking to navigate the complexity of clinical trial data and real-world data (RWD) systems, translating business needs into system requirements, oversee initiatives with full autonomy and lead analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces. Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership, you will actively shape long-term roadmaps, drive consensus through persuasive communication, and recommend optimal technology solutions to ensure efficient acquisition and management of clinical trial data.
  
Description of the area
  
This team is responsible for delivering software systems for the data acquisition and processing of Roche clinical trial data, serving as the source of truth across Roche Pharma. Foundational systems in this area include Roche’s electronic data capture (EDC) - Medidata Rave, non-CRF systems, and clinical data warehouses.
  
These systems are critical to drug development, powering clinical data review, safety reporting, operational insights for clinical teams, and support early development activities in the REDs. They provide data to the Analytical Data Science’s ecosystems to standardize and analyze data for regulatory submissions. In addition, standardized clinical data from these systems are essential to integrate with Roche’s specialized data modality platforms including omics, clinical imaging, and digital health technologies.
  
A key focus in this area will be to leverage emerging AI technologies to optimize clinical data acquisition and data management. This includes enriching metadata and building AI-ready datasets to enable autonomous agentic and human-in-the loop AI systems which are transforming the drug development process.

* Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, defining the problem space and driving comprehensive root cause analysis that may span organizational boundaries. * Impact& Strategy: Drives significant impact on projects and programs by ensuring the delivery of high-value solutions that align with business strategy. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, including advanced value analysis and risk assessment, and actively shapes long-term roadmaps.
* Complexity: Works typically on multiple systems across the sub-function, effectively managing highly ambiguous and evolving requirements. Demonstrates an end-to-end viewpoint to analyze problems, considering how data flows across systems.
* Business Domain& Technical Expertise: Uses in-depth knowledge of clinical data business processes and technical expertise in data integration and engineering to inform business strategies.

Qualifications
  
Education / Experience
  
  

* Experience: 7+ years as a Business Analyst/Consultant, with at least 4 years in the Life Sciences or Pharma Industry.
* Experience with Clinical Data Systems, Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems or Non-CRF data systems, clinical data warehouses or data lakes.
* Extensive experience overseeing initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale, and driving alignment across highly ambiguous spaces.
* Demonstrated advanced knowledge of Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts and practices.
* Strong communication skills to manage stakeholders and facilitate discussions between business and IT users globally.
* Familiar with Agile product delivery, backlog management, and delivering GxP validated systems

Technical Skills
  
  

* Ability to apply systems thinking to provide holistic and enterprise-wide consulting advice.
* Mastery in requirements and domain knowledge, with the ability to conduct comprehensive root cause analysis and advanced value and risk assessments.
* Experience with databases, SQL, scripting languages such as python, APIs, and data analytics tools

Wells Fargo is seeking a highly driven Lead Data Management Analyst / Product Owner to join the Wells Fargo Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) Data Management team.  
This role sits within the business and will lead strategic technology initiatives for our next-generation data platform that powers real-time trade and position data from Systems of Record (SoR) and integrates with the broader CIB Data Marketplace.  
The ideal candidate will combine product ownership, business analysis, project delivery, and data platform expertise to drive scalable, governed, and high-quality data solutions across the trade lifecycle.

Our team serves as the Approved Data Source (ADS) for CIB Trades and Positions, managing critical data platforms that support front-to-back business processes, regulatory needs, and enterprise data consumption.

As we modernize our data ecosystem, we are building a real-time, cloud-enabled, next-generation data platform to stream trade events from source systems, enable robust ETL and snapshot-based processing, and integrate seamlessly with the wider CIB Data Marketplace.

This role will act as the business-side product owner, partnering closely with technology, architecture, data governance, control, and business stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize delivery, improve data quality, and drive end-to-end execution.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own and drive delivery of strategic data platform initiatives as a Product Owner for CIB trade and position data.
* Translate business priorities and investment banking workflow requirements into clear product roadmaps, user stories, and technology solutions.
* Act as a bridge between business, technology, architecture, and governance teams to deliver scalable and controlled data products.
* Lead agile delivery ceremonies and support execution along with Scrum Master / delivery lead where needed.
* Drive the design and evolution of data flows across real-time streaming, ETL pipelines, and snapshot-based processing.
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams on modern data architecture, standards, and best practices for data access, lineage, documentation, controls, and remediation.
* Ensure the platform aligns with enterprise expectations around data quality, integrity, governance, and regulatory compliance.
* Identify new data sources and define frameworks to assess data suitability, quality, integration feasibility, and business value.
* Review complex business and technology problems, evaluate solution options, and make recommendations across tactical and strategic initiatives.
* Support the build-out of cloud-native and Lakehouse-oriented capabilities leveraging technologies such as S3, MongoDB, Iceberg, Flink, Parquet, and distributed data processing frameworks.
* Partner with stakeholders across business lines to resolve data quality issues, control gaps, and remediation actions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on current-state data challenges, metadata quality, and future-state data strategy.
* Lead project teams, coordinate execution across functions, and mentor junior team members.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Data Management, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Project Management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* Up to 10 yrs of strong experience in data management, business analysis, product ownership, and project delivery within financial services / investment banking.
* Experience working with data platforms, ETL pipelines, real-time data streaming, snapshots, and enterprise data integration.
* Strong knowledge of data governance, data quality, metadata management, data modeling, lineage, and control frameworks.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Proven experience driving initiatives through Agile/Scrum and/or traditional project management methodologies.
* Strong understanding of investment banking products, workflows, trade lifecycle, positions, and related data flows.
* Experience with DataLake / NetApp S3 / Lakehouse architectures and modern enterprise data platforms.
* Solid understanding of cloud-native architecture and exposure to Azure and/or GCP.
* Technical awareness of Java, Spring / Spring Boot, microservices, and modern distributed data ecosystems.
* Hands-on understanding of large-scale data processing technologies such as Apache Flink, Apache Iceberg, Parquet, and S3-based storage patterns.
* Strong SQL, Python and data analysis skills with the ability to assess data quality, trace issues, and recommend remediation.
* Familiarity with regulatory and governance expectations such as BCBS 239, GDPR, and enterprise data risk/control practices.
* Ability to engage with senior business and technology stakeholders, influence priorities, and drive alignment across competing demands.
* Excellent communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Exposure to LLM ecosystems, including prompt engineering, RAG, and MCP, is a plus.

**Job Expectations:**

* Operate as the business-side owner for strategic data platform capabilities supporting CIB trades and positions.
* Deliver initiatives end-to-end — from requirements shaping and solution design through execution, governance, and adoption.
* Establish strong partnerships across business, technology, architecture, compliance, and data governance teams.
* Drive high standards for data quality, integrity, control, and documentation across the platform.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, well-governed, and aligned to enterprise data strategy.
* Provide thought leadership on modernizing legacy data flows into real-time and cloud-native architectures.
* Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and control gaps, and lead remediation with clear accountability.
* Contribute to enterprise-wide conversations on data standards, architecture patterns, and governance strategy.

The **Analyst – Global Trade Content** is responsible for the accurate compilation, maintenance, validation, and quality assurance of global trade regulatory content. The analyst is also expected to actively utilize AI and digital tools to improve productivity, accuracy, consistency, and content quality while adhering to company governance and data privacy requirements.

* Conducts comprehensive research and analysis to interpret and update global trade regulations from official government sources.

title: Quantitative Rates Researcher
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking an experienced Quantitative Rates Researcher to support a leading investment bank’s algorithmic trading platform project.

The role involves evaluating AI-generated quantitative research and systematic trading strategies focused on fixed income and interest rate markets. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in quantitative finance, rates markets, statistical modeling, and backtesting methodologies to assess research quality, validate assumptions, and identify methodological flaws.

Prior experience with AI systems is not required. Strong domain expertise in quantitative finance and interest rate markets is the primary requirement.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Review and evaluate quantitative research outputs and systematic trading strategies focused on fixed income and interest rate markets.
* Identify research and backtesting issues, including lookahead bias, overfitting, data snooping, and unrealistic transaction cost assumptions.
* Evaluate backtesting frameworks, including rates-specific mechanics such as carry, roll-down analytics, and contract roll conventions.
* Assess the statistical rigor of signal construction, factor modeling, and alpha research.
* Review yield curve models, relative value strategies, and interest rate trading instruments.
* Validate model assumptions, implementation accuracy, and research methodologies.
* Evaluate strategies under realistic market conditions, accounting for transaction costs, liquidity constraints, and execution assumptions.
* Provide detailed written feedback with actionable recommendations to improve research quality and accuracy.
* Collaborate asynchronously with project coordinators to clarify findings and communicate technical insights.
* Contribute to improving quantitative research evaluation methodologies.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**
--------------------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in quantitative research, quantitative analysis, or quantitative finance.
* Strong expertise in fixed income analysis and interest rate markets.
* Advanced proficiency in Python or R for quantitative research and data analysis.
* Hands-on experience with Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and SciPy.
* Strong understanding of systematic trading strategy development and backtesting.
* Experience with yield curve modeling and carry/roll-down analytics.
* Knowledge of relative value trading strategies and interest rate market instruments.
* Familiarity with SOFR and Eurodollar instruments, as well as Treasury futures.
* Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, factor modeling, and alpha research.
* Understanding of transaction costs, liquidity constraints, and realistic trading assumptions.
* Ability to identify lookahead bias, overfitting, data snooping, and other research methodology flaws.
* Excellent analytical, written communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate complex quantitative concepts clearly and work effectively with distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience as a Quantitative Researcher, Quantitative Analyst, or Consultant specializing in fixed income or interest rate markets.
* Experience developing and backtesting systematic rates strategies at a hedge fund, asset management firm, or investment bank.
* Strong practical knowledge of rates trading, yield curve dynamics, and quantitative modeling.
* Experience reviewing and validating quantitative models against established quantitative finance best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to assess research quality, implementation fidelity, model assumptions, and statistical robustness.
